020 – 423 39 30 info@huizefrankendael.nl

Huize Frankendael is the last remaining country estate within the city of Amsterdam. Founded in the 17th century, the house was used by people of high distinction to enjoy friendship and nature.

While the city has since enclosed the estate, the joy remains. House, kitchen and garden are open throughout the year for the combination of nature, gastronomy and art & culture.

Restaurant Merkelbach

Restaurant Merkelbach (opens in a new tab) carries the name of former city architect Ben Merkelbach and is located in the coach house of Huize Frankendael. The kitchen fully endorses the Slow Food philosophy (opens in a new tab). In the formal garden, home to the terrace, you experience the seasons within the city. Reserve a table at Merkelbach (opens in a new tab).

Festivities and meetings

Besides the restaurant, Huize Frankendael has beautiful rooms:

  • the salons
  • the coach house
  • the boardrooms

These rooms accommodate groups of 2 to 300 for meetings, memorial gatherings and private dining, among other occasions. Huize Frankendael is also an official wedding venue in Amsterdam. The kitchen of restaurant Merkelbach takes care of the culinary side, prepared according to the Slow Food philosophy.
